verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same layout, and both split the three badge pills: FREE ENTRY sits alone under the date block while ALL AGES and TASTINGS float above the CTA. Both also push the date block against the left edge and crowd the date, badges and CTA into the bottom half. A sits higher, which leaves dead space at the bottom, and its 'Reserve a spot' line runs straight into the partner-mark box on the same baseline. B lowers the group so the URL line sits below the partner box instead of beside it, and the vertical spacing is slightly more even.
